name: NIF Holding (Italy) S.r.l.
via: NEOM Investment Fund / Public Investment Fund
note: Italian vehicle through which Saudi Arabia's NEOM Investment Fund (NIF, part of the PIF-owned NEOM giga-project) bought its stake in Technogym in December 2023. Technogym's 2025 annual report places the Public Investment Fund at the head of NIF Holding's control structure.
